In a directed graph G, LLMs need to generate a linear ordering of the nodes such that for every directed edge (u, v) ∈ E, node u precedes node v in the ordering. ... LLMs need to predict the label of a certain node which is labeled as '?' based on the labels of its neighbouring nodes.
